warnings: This is a Zn biofortification study, not CO2 study - extracted for different meta-analysis context
Split-plot design with genotypes as main plots and Zn treatments as sub-plots
Data spans two years (2009-2010 and 2010-2011) - each year should be treated as separate observations
Multiple genotypes tested - each genotype×treatment combination is a separate observation
Table 1 contains both grain Zn content AND phytic acid data - only extract Zn concentration
Figures 1a-d contain methionine and ascorbic acid data, not grain Zn concentration
WARNING: SCANNED PDF - Text may have OCR errors
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: SeM ± and CD values provided at bottom of Table 1 for treatments (T), varieties (V), and interactions
recon.control_definition: 0 kg ZnSO4/ha (Zn0) - no zinc fertilizer application
recon.treatment_definition: 20 kg ZnSO4/ha (Zn20) and 20 kg ZnSO4/ha + foliar spray of 0.5% ZnSO4 (Zn20+F)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: None - control clearly defined as zero Zn application
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract only grain Zn content data from Table 1. Each genotype×treatment×year combination represents one observation. For each genotype in each year: Zn0 = control, Zn20 = soil Zn treatment, Zn20+F = soil+foliar Zn treatment. Use SeM± values for variance (SE). Do not extract phytic acid, methionine, or ascorbic acid data as these are not primary outcomes for this meta-analysis. Total of 60 observations possible (10 genotypes × 3 treatments × 2 years).

table_descriptions.Table 1: Contains grain Zn content (mg/kg dry weight) and phytic acid (PA) data for 10 genotypes across 3 Zn treatments for both years
